description: A creative agriculture-themed aesthetic avoiding 'cliché leaf + green gradient' AI-slop. Uses warm bone-whites, deep forest greens, and earthy terracottas. Mobile-first design focusing on clarity for non-tech-savvy farmers, with generous whitespace and clear 3-step diagnosis flows.

rules: Avoid Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato for Headings.
Headings must use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight.
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line Height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
H1 MAXIMUM text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl. Do not use text-7xl+.
Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always tint neutral greys with a tiny bit of green/warmth.
Use Terracotta (#D36D4D) for disease severity/alerts, never standard red.
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.
CRITICAL: ONLY use primary / brand color for CTAs like button, form, etc. LIMIT the use of PRIMARY color.

surfaces: Headers: Use Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) if content scrolls under it. 1px delicate inner stroke.
Cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border, soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm or custom shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]).
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Subtle roundness, rounded-xl to rounded-2xl. Not excessively pill-shaped except for primary CTAs.

layouts.dashboard: Mode B (High Density Grid): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Primary diagnosis/upload area spans larger.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (e.g., p-6 or p-8).
layouts.mobile_first: Always start with grid-cols-1. Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile devices.

components.general: Use Shadcn components for interactive logic (Forms, Modals, Inputs) but HEAVILY CUSTOMIZE them via Tailwind to match the organic brand. Use .js extension (JSX) instead of .tsx.
components.upload_zone: Massive drag-and-drop area. border-2 border-dashed border-[#8CAE68] bg-[#FBFBF9] p-12 text-center rounded-2xl. Use Lucide icons.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-xl. Hover states must translate-y-[-2px] with increased shadow.
components.charts: Use Recharts (Chart.js is acceptable but Recharts is preferred in React). Use theme colors (Primary, Secondary, Accent) instead of default chart colors. Remove grid lines for a cleaner look.

rules: Hover states on all interactive elements.
Smooth entrance animations for diagnosis results and list items.
Exclude transforms from universal transitions (breaks animations).

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text. Check Terracotta and White.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility.forms: Clear error states. Do not rely solely on color to indicate severity (use icons).

images.description: Aerial farmland pattern. Best for Hero section background or abstract decorative headers.
Farmer hands with small plant/soil. Good for 'Get Started' or 'About' sections.
Macro shot of a green leaf. Perfect for the 'Scan History' or 'Upload Placeholder' visuals.
Fresh organic vegetables market. Use for the 'Market Prices' or 'Sell Produce' section headers.

media.rules: NEVER use placeholder URLs. Use the provided images.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, BUT NEVER on dropdowns, select menus, or any surface that requires crisp readability underneath.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` (note the .js extension).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Ensure you write .js or .jsx files, not .tsx files.
